Figure 3.6: Modeling of Abstract Platform data types
Class
ApplicationDataType (abstract)
Note
ApplicationDataType defines a data type from the application point of view. Especially it should be
used whenever something "physical" is at stake.
An ApplicationDataType represents a set of values as seen in the application model, such as
measurement units. It does not consider implementation details such as bit-size, endianess, etc.
It should be possible to model the application level aspects of a VFB system by using
ApplicationDataTypes only.
